title: keys buffer grown to [10] but up to 11 keys can now be collected in one frame — silent drop
detail: The pre-existing surface already collects ~5 keys (P/Space/A/M/Esc per the switch); this diff adds S, Up, Down, Left, Right, Enter — 6 more. 11 > 10, and every append is silently guarded by `keys_n < len(keys)`, so an 11th simultaneous keypress is dropped with no error.
recommended_fix: Size the array to the true case count (e.g. [16]Key) or assert/log on overflow instead of silently dropping the key.

title: Spec design note says reduced-motion pins to a mid-envelope 0.99; code pins to 1.0
detail: The frozen spec's stated static value (0.99 mid-envelope) contradicts the shipped 1.0 full-width pin in the same PR's diff; the PR body argues for 1.0 but the spec text was left stale.
recommended_fix: Update the spec design note (or a change-log line) to record the 1.0 full-width ruling so the spec and code agree.

title: Spec Code Map names intents Settings_Toggle/Panel_Navigate/Panel_Activate/Scale_Step; code ships Toggle_Settings/Settings_Navigate/Settings_Activate
detail: The frozen spec names four intents including a dedicated Scale_Step; the implementation ships three differently-named intents with no Scale_Step. Same PR, contradictory identifiers.
recommended_fix: Reconcile the spec's intent names (and the Scale_Step claim) with the shipped three-intent design via a spec change-log entry.

title: hud_zero_scale test emulates view_compute's guard itself — it tests the test, not the code
detail: The test copies the guard inline instead of calling view_compute, so if view_compute's actual guard regresses, this test still passes. Vacuous as a pin of the claimed behavior.
recommended_fix: Call view_compute (with a minimal Balance) or extract the guard into a tested helper the real path also uses.

title: sla_row_rect leaves x=8 and width=740 unscaled in an otherwise full hud() scaling pass
detail: The y, inset, and height were scaled (r3 blocker 3) but the row's x origin and 740px width stayed raw. At x1.50, text is 24px and the hit/highlight rect covers proportionally less of the drawn row than at x1.00.
recommended_fix: Route x and width through hud(v, 8) and hud(v, 740) for consistency with the rest of the scaled pass.

title: Doc comment for tmp_settings_path is attached to the wrong proc (rnd_palette_for_test)
detail: The multi-line uniqueness-rationale comment sits above rnd_palette_for_test, which has nothing to do with temp paths; the actual tmp_settings_path proc below carries no doc.
recommended_fix: Move the comment block down onto tmp_settings_path.

title: Palette derivation cited as both Brettel-class and Machado 2009 within the same diff
evidence:
spec: "simulate the canon tokens under each deficiency (Brettel-class linear RGB transforms)"
palette.json: "simulator-derived by tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py, Machado 2009 severity-1.0"
pr body: "Machado et al. 2009 severity-1.0 matrices"
detail: Two different simulator families are named for the same derivation in the same PR; a verifier cannot tell which the tables actually implement from the docs alone.
recommended_fix: Pick one citation (Machado 2009, per the r3 rework notes) and fix the spec's Design Note.
